comment: wizcmds.c wiz_intrinsic() 1068: slippery fingers goes through make_glib((int) newtimeout). A debug-mode elven Ranger takes the default 30 turns, then adds 2147483647: the long sum 2147483677 wraps to a negative int, itimeout() makes it 0 and Glib ends, though the message still says 'increased by 2147483647'. #timeout then reports no timed properties. Seed, date, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
